activity_summary: At night the jaw was hot to the hand, and it did not ease. You had said after Thursday, and you meant the king. Four shillings and eighteenpence stayed where John had said them. You did not open the coffer. Love's Labour's Won is when this king is buried.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Named the heat, and left both prices on Thursday's call.

entities.name: four shillings
entities.context: Mentioned in Hot to the hand

entities.name: eighteenpence
entities.context: Mentioned in Hot to the hand

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: After Thursday. I said so, and I meant the king.
